wave

components · 0.3.0 · E5 · aj-c-wave

A recording's waveform: the memo's one fixed shape (the 14:05 phrase) at a fixed pitch, repeated along the row, aria-hidden. A wider row shows more of the phrase; the bars never widen. The duration beside it carries the information. Draws in once on arrival.
